trigger: requirePreviousClosure or equivalent check at an authoring-to-native boundary
authoringRule: A one-time previous=current and velocity=0 synchronization may establish authoring boundary continuity only when physics time and substep identity are unchanged. It is never native-step evidence.
nativeRule: A native continuity claim requires the exact previous accepted native substep; an authoring reset invalidates that claim.
nonClaims: does not prove body or self contact
does not prove a native solver substep
does not lower any existing strain, stitch, contact, browser or user-acceptance gate
